input: Our Cortex-X925 prime core cluster reaches 95C junction temp within 30 seconds of sustained ML inference load. The X925's 10-wide decode pipeline generates significantly more heat than the X4 it replaced. Thermal logs show the power_allocator governor capping at 3.0W allocated power, but the actual power draw is 3.8W before throttle kicks in — there's a 200ms overshoot window. cat /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone0/policy shows 'power_allocator'. We tried reducing sustainable_power from 3000 to 2500 but it tanks performance by 40%. How do we tune the PID coefficients (k_p, k_i, k_d) in the power allocator to reduce overshoot without destroying throughput?
